evals.name: explicit-explainer
evals.prompt: /writing:write-x Walk Utilities Code §37.0561(c) and (f) through (j), as enrolled in S.B. 6 (89th Legislature). The only source is evals/x-explainer/sb6-37.0561.md. Quote the enrolled text in subsection order. Do not add a fee, a rate, a deadline, or an objection that the excerpt does not contain.
evals.expected_output: Version named in the hook, subsection walk in enrolled order, statutory phrases quoted from the excerpt, verify-it-yourself close with the capitol.texas.gov source link, share-ask self-reply. No invented objection list.

evals.name: indirect-set-record-straight
evals.prompt: /writing:write-x People are misstating the large-load standards in enrolled S.B. 6. The only source is evals/x-explainer/sb6-37.0561.md. Set the record straight from that excerpt. Do not supply an objection, a fee, or a rate the excerpt does not contain.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes this as a governing-text explainer and routes to the explainer format rather than a 5-7 tweet narrative. Uses only the enrolled excerpt.

evals.name: proposed-rule-stakes-first
evals.prompt: /writing:write-x Explain the study fee and the financial-commitment provisions in enrolled Utilities Code §37.0561 for a large-load customer. The only source is evals/x-explainer/sb6-37.0561.md. Stakes first. The excerpt does not set a dollar-per-megawatt rate. Do not add one.
evals.expected_output: Stakes-first shape: hook states a hard number that is in the excerpt, one provision per post, a scenario-question post, other filers named as expectation, close on §37.0561 and the $100,000 study fee. Not a section walk. No rate the excerpt does not contain.

notes: Source record is the enrolled excerpt in sb6-37.0561.md, quoted from https://capitol.texas.gov/tlodocs/89R/billtext/html/SB00006F.htm. Both grader modes read that file. Walk mode has 9 checks. Rule mode has 11. Grade a run dir (containing outputs/thread.md) with: python3 grade.py <run_dir> [walk|rule]. python3 grade.py --self-check fails if a banned invented-instrument string is anywhere under plugins/writing. Historical scores through writing 2.10.1 were produced against source records that have been deleted. Those scores are not reusable and are not restated here. planted-thread.md holds two sentences marked false (a form-word swap, and a right the statute does not grant) plus three controls (shown arithmetic, a pure filer sentence, a stance self-reply). The checker prompt's examples are a private invoice, not a law. grade.py records fact_check beside summary: independent, fallback, not-run, incomplete, or fact-check: absent. Only independent is the independent result. fact_check_quote_misses lists double-quoted traced evidence that is not a whitespace-normalized substring of the excerpt. A miss does not change summary.total.
output_format: Harness asks agents for drafts first, then '## FINAL' with posts separated by lines of ---, self-replies starting 'Self-reply', checklists under '## Verification'. '## Fact-check' follows the self-replies and is not graded.
